objectives.en: Name a circle, a square and a triangle.
objectives.yo: Sọ orúkọ circle, square àti triangle.
objectives.pcm: Call the name of circle, square and triangle.

objectives.en: Pick the right shape from a spoken clue.
objectives.yo: Yan ìrísí tó tọ́ látinú ìtọ́kasí tí a sọ.
objectives.pcm: Pick the correct shape from clue wey person talk.

curriculum.objective: Name a circle, a triangle, a square and a rectangle
curriculum.note: Lagos State teaches plane shapes in Kindergarten first term week 5; they do not appear in its Nursery 1 or Nursery 2 number work at all.

say.en: Look at a plate. Look at a window. Shapes are around you.
say.pcm: Look plate. Look window. Shape dey around you.
say.yo: Wo àwo. Wo fèrèsé. Ìrísí wà káàkiri yí ọ ká.

say.en: Today you will name three shapes. Listen for each clue.
say.pcm: Today you go name three shape. Listen for each clue.
say.yo: Lónìí o ó sọ orúkọ ìrísí mẹ́ta. Fetí sí ìtọ́kasí kọ̀ọ̀kan.

say.en: Think of your ball. Think of your window. Their shapes differ.
say.pcm: Think about your ball. Think about your window. Their shape no be the same.
say.yo: Ronú nípa bọ́ọ̀lù rẹ. Ronú nípa fèrèsé rẹ. Ìrísí wọn kò jọra.

say.en: A circle is round all over. A square has four equal sides. A triangle has only three sides.
say.pcm: Circle dey round everywhere. Square get four sides wey equal. Triangle get only three sides.
say.yo: Circle yíká káàkiri. Square ní ẹ̀gbẹ́ mẹ́rin dọ́gba. Triangle ní ẹ̀gbẹ́ mẹ́ta péré.

say.en: Let us try together. It has three straight sides. What shape is it?
say.pcm: Make we try together. E get three straight sides. Which shape be am?
say.yo: Jẹ́ kí a jọ gbìyànjú. Ó ní ẹ̀gbẹ́ mẹ́ta tààrà. Ìrísí wo ni?

say.en: Your turn. It is round like a plate. What shape is it?
say.pcm: Na your turn. E round like plate. Which shape be am?
say.yo: Ìwọ ná. Ó yíká bí àwo. Ìrísí wo ni?

say.en: Good try. Let us look at the shapes again.
say.pcm: Good try. Make we look the shapes again.
say.yo: Ìgbìyànjú rere. Jẹ́ ká tún wo àwọn ìrísí náà.

say.en: Your last turn. It has four sides, all the same. What shape is it?
say.pcm: Your last turn. E get four equal sides. Which shape be am?
say.yo: Ìwọ tún gbìyànjú lẹ́ẹ̀kan. Ó ní ẹ̀gbẹ́ mẹ́rin dọ́gba. Ìrísí wo ni?

say.en: Well done. Tomorrow we find shapes at home.
say.pcm: You do well. Tomorrow we find shape for house.
say.yo: O ṣe dáadáa. Lọ́la a ó wá ìrísí nínú ilé.
